entry.title: H99 Coronets — Tin of 10
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, cola, dark rum or bourbon (projected)
Occasion: Quick premium smoke, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Espresso, cedar, leather, black pepper and restrained natural sweetness define H99's rich, polished take on Liga Privada. The distinctive Connecticut River Valley H99 wrapper combines Stalk-Cut Habano and Corojo '99 genetics over Mexican San Andrés and a multinational filler blend, giving the compact 4″ × 32 Coronet considerably more pedigree and expected intensity than its size suggests. Untasted here, so Strength 8 and Quality 8 remain projections and Flavour stays unrated.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Cigar Hut currently lists Liga Privada H99 Coronets from A$119 with purchasable package options. No Australian single of the exact Coronet has been verified. Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
